meta.title: Snowflake Premier Partner and Claude Certified Partner
meta.description: A Snowflake Premier and CoCo Preferred Partner, and a Claude Certified Partner: certified depth on governed data, Claude agents that act on it, delivered across the Americas.

hero.title: Two partner networks. <hl>One team</hl> that answers for the build.
hero.description: Snowflake is the agentic control plane: governed data, Cortex AI and Cortex AI Gateway. Claude is the model that runs inside it and around it. Viewnear holds a recognized standing in both networks and builds agentic solutions that start with the right data.

comparisonHeading.title: Three ways to get there
comparisonHeading.intro: Every leader weighs building in-house, hiring a global systems integrator, or partnering with a specialist. Here is where the three models differ.

comparison.inhouse: Hiring and ramping a team before the build starts
comparison.big3: Mobilization through a large delivery process
comparison.viewnear: 8–16 weeks to first value, demos every sprint

comparison.inhouse: Whoever can be hired and retained
comparison.big3: Staffed from a large bench, often in layers

comparison.inhouse: Learned on the job, funded in-house
comparison.big3: One of many platforms they cover
comparison.viewnear: Premier Partner specialists, end to end

comparison.inhouse: Pilots on whichever model the team already knows
comparison.big3: One of several AI practices, staffed per account
comparison.viewnear: Claude Certified Partner, Claude agents in production

comparison.big3: Often split across practices and subcontractors
comparison.viewnear: One team, owned start to finish

comparison.big3: The engagement continues at day rates
comparison.viewnear: Documented and run: by the team, or by Viewnear as a managed service

cta.title: Put a certified partner on it.
cta.subtitle: Tell us where the organization stands, whether that is Snowflake procurement, a migration, or a process that should be running with an agent, and we'll bring the certified team to move it forward.

snowflake.title: Governed data and the AI layer, on Snowflake
snowflake.body: Premier Partner and CoCo Preferred Partner. Migrations, governed foundations, and Cortex AI through Cortex AI Gateway, delivered by SnowPro-certified architects and engineers.

claude.title: Agentic solutions, built with Claude
claude.body: A Claude Certified Partner in the Claude Partner Network. Claude Certified Architects putting Claude on the work still done by hand, with MCP connectors into the system of record and a person approving what matters.

networks.together: Built together: agentic solutions that start with the right data, governed on Snowflake and reasoning with Claude.
